method: Local Vite production preview. Three cold Lighthouse navigations per device, serial; default simulated throttling. Independent per-metric medians. Scores/timing are advisory until a CI-runner baseline exists. Separate unthrottled network capture: fresh context, cache disabled, DPR 1, networkidle + 2.5 seconds, no scrolling. Bytes are decoded resource bodies, not transfer or executed bytes.
comparisonLimit: Local validation of the portable manual CI harness, not a GitHub-hosted CI baseline. Chromium 159.0.8154.6 / Lighthouse 13.6.0 differ from Phase D Chrome157 / Lighthouse13.4.1. Do not attribute differences to website improvement or replace original baseline.
policyValidation: After the six-run validation, Script collection was widened to include cross-origin resources; existing accepted input URLs are all first-party, so their measurements are unchanged. Five Node policy tests pass, including rejecting unobservable cross-origin script sizes.
